name: Model Router
description: Classify each turn with a small local model and route it to the best specialist model, narrowing the tool surface per category.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false the plugin is a no-op and every turn uses the default model.

debug.description: Enable verbose per-turn diagnostics (classifier completion snapshot + raw classifier output). May contain prompt-derived text; off by default, enable only while troubleshooting routing.

agents.description: Map of OpenClaw agent id -> routing section for that agent. Only agents with a section are routed; every other agent is skipped entirely (no classifier call, no model override, no tool cap).

categories.description: Map of category name -> routing decision. The classifier must return one of these keys.

model.description: provider/model ref to route this category to (e.g. ollama/qwen3.8:27b).

toolsAllow.description: Optional cap on the tool surface for this category. Omit to leave the default surface unchanged.

categoryDescriptions.description: Optional map of category name -> classifier guidance. Keys should match configured category names.

defaultCategory.description: Category used when the classifier output does not match a known key.

classifierModel.description: Small, fast model used only to classify the turn. Must be a valid provider/model ref (e.g. ollama/qwen3.5:2b).

classifierTimeoutMs.description: Hard budget for the classification call. On timeout the turn falls back to the default model.

fallbackModel.description: Optional model to use when classification fails or times out. Omit to keep the session's default model.
